top_deficiency_types.title: Provide care and assistance to perform activities of daily living for any resident who is unable.
top_deficiency_types.category: Quality of Life and Care Deficiencies

top_deficiency_types.title: Develop and implement a complete care plan that meets all the resident's needs, with timetables and actions that can be measured.
top_deficiency_types.category: Resident Assessment and Care Planning Deficiencies

top_deficiency_types.title: Provide appropriate care for residents who are continent or incontinent of bowel/bladder, appropriate catheter care,  and appropriate care  to prevent urinary tract infections.
top_deficiency_types.category: Quality of Life and Care Deficiencies

top_deficiency_types.title: Provide pharmaceutical services to meet the needs of each resident and employ or obtain the services of a licensed pharmacist.
Ensure that residents are free from significant medication errors.
Keep aisles, corridors, and exits free of obstruction in case of emergency.
Install emergency lighting that can last at least 1 1/2 hours.
Ensure that special areas are constructed so that walls can resist fire for one hour or have an approved fire extinguishing system.
Have approved installation, maintenance and testing program for fire alarm systems.
Inspect, test, and maintain automatic sprinkler systems.
